description: Every olevba finding security_scan.py may meet in ReDim's VBA, by module, with the reason ReDim has it. A finding missing here fails the scan. Keys read "Type: keyword" as olevba reports them, compared without case; values name a reason below.

reasons.prose: An English word in a comment, a name, or a demo's text. olevba matches its keywords as whole words anywhere in the code, comments included.
reasons.chr: Chr and ChrW build characters from their codes: icon glyphs, key names, and separators.
reasons.encoded: Numbers and short words that happen to read as hex or base64, such as 2147483647 or LEFT. The scan passes an encoded-looking string only when it is 16 characters or fewer, and olevba scans every decoded string for its keywords as well.
reasons.repo-url: The license header's link to the ReDim repository.
reasons.auto-open: Auto_Open builds the demo's interface when the workbook opens.
reasons.ui-win32: ReDimUI declares Windows API functions to measure text (gdi32), to read the clipboard, the pointer, key states, and system settings (user32, kernel32), and to read the two registry values that hold the Windows dark mode and accent color (RegGetValueW in advapi32).
reasons.ui-memory: CopyMemory (RtlMoveMemory in kernel32) copies text between VBA strings and clipboard memory.
reasons.ui-run: Application.Run calls the handler procedures an app names, such as OnClick and OnChange; the word also appears in comments.
reasons.ui-settimer: A comment naming ReDimHost's timer. ReDimUI does not call SetTimer.
reasons.host-win32: ReDimHost declares SetTimer and KillTimer (user32) for its frame timer, GetKeyState, GetFocus, GetClassNameW, PostMessageW, and MapVirtualKeyW (user32) to route keys, and timeBeginPeriod and timeEndPeriod (winmm.dll) for the timer's resolution.
reasons.host-timer: SetTimer arms the Windows timer whose callback, a VBA procedure in ReDimHost, draws animation frames and runs deferred work.
reasons.auto-close: Auto_Close stops ReDim's timer and releases its key bindings when the workbook closes.
reasons.winmm: timeBeginPeriod and timeEndPeriod in winmm.dll set the system timer's resolution while ReDim animates.
reasons.example-url: Placeholder text in a demo's text box. Nothing requests it.
reasons.pokeapi: The ReDex demo reads Pokemon data from PokeAPI over HTTPS through ROneCOne's HttpClient, and caches sprite images in the temp folder as redex_<id>.png.
reasons.rc-win32: ROneCOne declares Windows API functions for its Process surface (CreateProcessW and pipes in kernel32), its Hash surface (bcrypt.dll), native delegates (DispCallFunc in oleaut32.dll), and timing.
reasons.rc-process: ROneCOne's Process surface starts a program when an app calls it: a command line through cmd.exe with WScript.Shell's Exec, or CreateProcessW with pipes. ReDim and its demos never call it.
reasons.rc-files: ROneCOne's File and Directory surfaces read, write, copy, move, and delete files when an app calls them (ADODB.Stream, Scripting.FileSystemObject, Kill, Open For Binary). Two demos write files, both in the temp folder: ReDex caches sprite images and Widget Gallery replaces a logo image.
reasons.rc-createobject: CreateObject makes COM objects by name: WScript.Shell for processes, ADODB for files and databases, Scripting.FileSystemObject, MSXML2.DOMDocument.6.0, VBScript.RegExp, and WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1.
reasons.rc-hash: ROneCOne's Hash surface computes digests with Windows CNG in bcrypt.dll.
reasons.rc-native: DispCallFunc in oleaut32.dll calls a native function by its address, for ROneCOne's native delegates.
reasons.rc-memory: CopyMemory (RtlMoveMemory in kernel32) copies bytes between buffers.
reasons.rc-callbyname: CallByName reads properties and calls methods by name, which is how ROneCOne invokes the callbacks an app gives it.
reasons.rc-xor: Bitwise Xor in ROneCOne's hash functions.
reasons.rc-task-run: Task.Run starts an app's procedure as a task; the word also appears in comments.
reasons.rc-http-put: The HTTP method PUT, in the HttpClient's PutAsync.
reasons.rc-register: CancellationToken.Register, which records a callback. olevba reads Register as the Excel 4 macro REGISTER.
reasons.rc-event-name: A constant named ROLE_FILE_CHANGE. olevba reads any name ending in _Change as an ActiveX event handler.
reasons.doc-guid: The workbook's document module holds no code, only Excel's attribute lines. Its VB_Base line names Excel's Workbook or Worksheet class by GUID, which reads as hex.
